card.name: Inside GnRH and split drug names
card.fires_on: Mainly the middle of the abbreviation GnRH (Gn, RH) in 'GnRH agonists', and the middle of split brand or word forms like 'co-administration' and ZOLADEX. Also a few scattered words such as exposure or maintain.

modes.label: GnRH abbreviation
modes.description: The Gn or RH pieces of GnRH before the word agonist in hormone-therapy labels.
modes.example: Have been reported in patients receiving<< Gn>>RH agonists.

modes.label: Split drug or word parts
modes.description: Middle pieces of a brand name or hyphenated word, such as co-administration or ZOLADEX.

modes.label: Scattered verbs and nouns
modes.description: Single words like exposure or maintain in interaction or dosing sentences.
modes.example: Capmatinib increased rosuvastatin<< exposure>> more than 2.1-fold.

card.writes: It slightly pushes toward removal words and away from abstract or prefix terms, with no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires inside the abbreviation GnRH and in broken-up drug or hyphenated words, plus a few stray words.
